Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one transparent HD cartoon game sprite, SMDATE2.BMP frame 011.
References: Image 1 is the exact original and is authoritative for this pose, camera, expression and silhouette. Image 2 is the approved Johnny character identity sheet. Image 3 is the approved detailed cartoon drawing style. Image 4 is the approved lighter skin palette. Their poses are not pose references.
Draw one full-body adult Johnny in original 011's low horizontal falling/crawling landing pose, with shorts and bent legs to IMAGE-LEFT and head/shoulders to IMAGE-RIGHT. His torso is stretched almost horizontal, low to the implied ground, and turned away enough to show more back. Head bows down-right beneath the sailor cap; cap brim, hair and beard obscure most of the face. Do not turn him to smile at the camera. The near/right foreground arm supports the landing: shoulder at upper-right, upper arm goes down to a bent elbow, forearm then reaches down-right to a flat open palm at far lower-right. Far arm reaches backward toward upper-left behind his back, bent with the hand at upper-left. Legs trail left, knee bends lift a bare foot at far left, and the other leg is mostly occluded by the shorts and foreground bent leg. Preserve only the leg/foot segments visible in the exact source. One naturally connected supporting hand, no extra arms. Match the original's wide, low silhouette rather than a running pose.
Identity/style: lean lanky castaway, long rounded nose, shaggy dark brown hair, full scruffy dark beard, white sailor cap with projecting black brim, narrow gold band and black anchor, ragged white shorts, bare feet. Clean confident black cartoon outlines, warm lighter peach skin, controlled cel shading matching the approved references. The original's red checkerboard pixels are diagnostic skin, not clothing or pattern.
Composition: entire cap, fingers and feet visible, centered with ample transparent padding. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Omit original gray ground shadow. No scenery, floor, text, panel layout or extra pose. Only the single requested sprite.
